description: The line plot illustrates the Micro F1 (%) performance of the KnowPrompt model when trained using varying numbers of synthetic training samples generated by large language models (LLMs), across four different sampling strategies: TACRED, TACRED-Revisit, Re-TACRED, and SemEval. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Samples Generated,” is categorical and displays four discrete values: K=8, K=16, K=32, and K=64, representing the number of samples generated per relation. The y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, is linear and ranges from 20% to 55%, with major tick marks at intervals of 5%. The blue line with circular markers (TACRED) starts at approximately 23% at K=8, rises to 28% at K=16, peaks at 30.5% at K=32, then slightly declines to 29.5% at K=64. The orange line with triangular markers (TACRED-Revisit) begins at 23.5% at K=8, increases to 29.5% at K=16, reaches 31% at K=32, and then decreases slightly to 30% at K=64. The green line with diamond markers (Re-TACRED) starts at 35% at K=8, climbs to 40.5% at K=16, peaks sharply at 50.5% at K=32, and then drops to 48% at K=64. The red line with square markers (SemEval) begins at 42% at K=8, rises steadily to 45% at K=16, continues to 47.5% at K=32, and reaches its highest point at 51.5% at K=64, showing a consistent upward trend across all sample sizes.
